Name: Extra Fashion Sense Tokens
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This is just a small utility mod that adds (so far) two new tokens, usable in a Content Patcher content pack, for mod authors to use to get some outfit information from Fashion Sense that otherwise is not exposed via a token of its own. This has some niche uses and if you're not already sure you need this mod, you probably don't, so don't worry about it.

[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Usage For Players[/b]
This mod does nothing on its own. There is no benefit to installing this as a user if another mod that you are using does not require it.

[b]Usage For Mod Authors[/b]
This mod adds two new tokens. Their names and outputs are the following:

[list]
[*]{{Spiderbuttons.ExtraFashionSenseTokens/HasOutfit}} - This works like HasFlag, except instead of being a list of received mail and such, it's a list of the names of every Outfit the current player has saved in their Fashion Sense menu, if they have any at all. You probably want to use it with a |contains= check or something.[/*]
[*]{{Spiderbuttons.ExtraFashionSenseTokens/CurrentOutfit}} - This outputs the name of the saved outfit that the current player is wearing, if any.[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/Spiderbuttons/ExtraFashionSenseTokens]Source Code[/url]
